map.参照物峰面积 520000、浓度 1 mg/mL → 响应=520000；组分峰: Reference peak area 520000 at 1 mg/mL gives a response of 520000; component peak area 460000 at 1 mg/mL gives a response of 460000; RRF = 460000/520000 = 0.885 and RCF = 1/0.885 = 1.13.
map.组分称样量 qty=10 mg，校正后量=correctedQty=qty×RC: Component mass qty = 10 mg gives correctedQty = qty x RCF = 10 x 1.13 = 11.3 mg.
